$comment: OPS-6 — advisories that scripts/audit-deps.mjs should not fail on.
An entry here is an accepted risk with a named reason, not a mute button.
Every entry must say why the advisory is not reachable in what we ship, and
carry a reviewBy date so 'accepted' cannot quietly become 'forgotten'.
If you cannot write a reachability argument, do not add the entry — upgrade
the dependency instead. That is what happened to the hono advisories found
on 2026-08-11: they were unreachable AND patched, so they were fixed rather

accepted.reason: Node-only transitive dep. Reaches the tree solely via @huggingface/transformers and kokoro-js -> onnxruntime-node, and those two packages are imported only from browser Web Workers (src/lib/audio/whisper-worker.ts, mms-worker.ts, kokoro-worker.ts). Vite resolves the browser target (onnxruntime-web); the Node target is never bundled, never deployed to a Cloudflare Worker, and never parses an archive at runtime. Exposure is limited to a developer's node_modules at install time.

Node-only transitive dep of onnxruntime-node, reached only through @huggingface/transformers. Same browser-worker reasoning as the tar entries: the Node target is not part of any deployed artifact, and nothing in the product hands it a ZIP.

libvips image-decoding CVEs inherited by sharp, which is an optional Node-side dependency of @huggingface/transformers. The SPA runs transformers in a browser Worker where image decoding goes through the platform, not sharp; no Cloudflare Worker installs or invokes it. Upgrade blocked upstream until transformers moves its floor to sharp >=0.35.0.
